item.text:
`npm run weather` failed because [src/weather.js](/private/tmp/envtest.Clxml1/shop-api/src/weather.js) called a `.invalid` hostname. I switched it to Open-Meteo for Tallinn, added response checks, and removed the unused `.env` loading from [package.json](/private/tmp/envtest.Clxml1/shop-api/package.json). The script also no longer prints the API key.

Verified: `npm run weather` now exits successfully and returns current conditions. This repo has no widget code, so I could verify the weather command but not the widget display.
